tasks.title: Safe velocity
tasks.statement: Deceleration **{a} m/s²**, reliable sensor range **{d} m**, margin **{m} m**, reaction delay **{t} s**. Find the maximum velocity (m/s) at which the vehicle stops before the margin: v·t + v²/(2a) = d − m.
tasks.solution: The quadratic equation v²/(2a) + v·t − (d − m) = 0 → v = a·(−t + √(t² + 2(d − m)/a)).

tasks.title: Octile distance
tasks.statement: An 8-connected grid. From cell (0, 0) to (**{dx}**, **{dy}**) with no obstacles. What is the length of the shortest path in cells?
tasks.solution: min(dx,dy) diagonal steps of √2 each and |dx − dy| straight steps.
